# Helper protocol messages

`tinkerpad-plugin-v1`, one JSON object per line over the helper's stdin and stdout.
What each message means, and the rules around them, are in
[PLUGINS.md](../PLUGINS.md) §5. These are the shapes, written by the
same code that sends them.

A field this build doesn't know is ignored in both directions, so a
newer core and an older helper keep working.

## Core to helper

```json
{
  "type": "hello",
  "protocol": "tinkerpad-plugin-v1",
  "plugin_dir": "/plugins/python",
  "scratch_dir": "/scratch/python"
}
```

```json
{
  "type": "run",
  "id": "7",
  "main": "/playgrounds/scratch-1/main.py",
  "dir": "/playgrounds/scratch-1",
  "kind": "statements"
}
```

```json
{
  "type": "cancel",
  "id": "7"
}
```

```json
{
  "type": "shutdown"
}
```

## Helper to core

```json
{
  "type": "ready",
  "name": "python helper",
  "version": "1.0"
}
```

```json
{
  "type": "stdout",
  "id": "7",
  "data": "aGVsbG8K"
}
```

```json
{
  "type": "exited",
  "id": "7",
  "code": 0,
  "duration_ms": 12
}
```

```json
{
  "type": "failed",
  "id": "7",
  "message": "the file did not compile",
  "diagnostics": []
}
```

```json
{
  "type": "retiring",
  "reason": "the module cache has grown too large"
}
```

## Hooks

A hook is a request with an `id`, answered by a `result` with the same
one. The request names the playground; the answer may ask for files to
be written inside it, and may carry settings for the language server.

A manifest lists the hooks its helper answers; one it doesn't list is
never sent.

```json
{
  "type": "playground_opened",
  "id": "12",
  "playground": {
    "id": "01J0TESTPLAYGROUND000001",
    "name": "Scratch 1",
    "language": "python",
    "kind": "statements",
    "dir": "/playgrounds/scratch-1",
    "mainFile": "/playgrounds/scratch-1/main.py",
    "createdMs": 0,
    "tags": [],
    "pinned": false
  },
  "open": [
    {
      "id": "01J0TESTPLAYGROUND000001",
      "name": "Scratch 1",
      "language": "python",
      "kind": "statements",
      "dir": "/playgrounds/scratch-1",
      "mainFile": "/playgrounds/scratch-1/main.py",
      "createdMs": 0,
      "tags": [],
      "pinned": false
    }
  ]
}
```

```json
{
  "type": "result",
  "id": "12",
  "files": [],
  "lsp_config": null
}
```
